items.question: No preferred nail tech?
items.answer: Pick "Any Polished Team 1" or "Any Polished Team 2." Not sure? Browse artist portfolios on the booking site.

items.question: Why does a different tech's name show on my confirmation?
items.answer: "Any Professional" auto-assigns a placeholder name. We reassign you to the best available artist, so it may change.

items.question: Do I book removal separately?
items.answer: No — we handle gel, GelX or acrylic removal during your visit.

items.question: Not sure which design level to pick?
items.answer: Book any level to hold your time. Tell your artist your vision at the appointment and we'll take it from there.

items.question: Do you take walk-ins?
items.answer: Appointments are preferred, but walk-ins and same-day are always welcome. Booked ahead? Your time is always honored.

items.question: What's your cancellation policy?
items.answer: We ask for 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Full details live on our policies page .

items.question: What do you specialize in?
items.answer: GelX, hard gel, BIAB, Russian gel, acrylic, custom nail art and luxury pedicures.

items.question: What makes your pedicures special?
items.answer: Signature CBD and 24K Gold treatments. Watch The Latest for seasonal pedicures, coming soon.

items.question: Do you take group bookings?
items.answer: Yes — parties and events with special group rates, extended Golden Hours and custom packages. See our group booking page .

items.question: Do you sell gift cards?
items.answer: Yes — buy online via the Shop tab on our booking site. They're delivered digitally.

items.question: How do cash rewards work?
items.answer: Pay cash and earn digital stamps: a free stamp to sign up, one per $50 spent, $10 off at four stamps — plus $10 off in your birthday month.

items.question: Do you validate parking?
items.answer: Yes — five hours at Joe's Auto Parks with a $100+ cash purchase. Bring your ticket to the front desk.
